scripts.which: which frida-compile && frida-compile --version && which frida && frida --version
scripts.dev:android: npm run build && node utils/run-android.js com.noodlecake.drtc
scripts.dev:android:package: npm run build:package && cross-var adb push ./build/%npm_package_name%-%npm_package_version%.zip /storage/emulated/0/ && node utils/run-android.js com.noodlecake.drtc
scripts.init:android: npx cap add android && node -e "const fs = require('fs-extra'); fs.copySync('utils/android', 'android', { overwrite: true });"
scripts.build:apk: cd android && gradlew assembleRelease && echo APK: ./android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
scripts.tag:dev: node -e "const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:T.Z]/g, '').slice(2, 14);require('child_process').execSync('cross-var git tag %npm_package_version%-dev.' + ts + ' -m \"dev build\"', {stdio: 'inherit'})"
scripts.dev:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npm run tag:dev && npm run install:apk && adb shell am force-stop com.noodlecake.drtc && adb shell monkey -p com.noodlecake.drtc 1 && adb logcat -s Xposed
scripts.dev:apk:reload: adb shell am force-stop com.noodlecake.drtc && adb shell monkey -p com.noodlecake.drtc 1 && adb logcat -s Xposed
